narrative.overview: A dark operational launcher pairs compact application tiles with real Homepage telemetry. Tactile gradients and inset highlights give each target a clear boundary. Semantic color reflects reported state, while idle services remain quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian canvas, fine borders, and inset surface highlights.
Figtree labels with steady JetBrains Mono telemetry.
Two-up mobile launch tiles and three balanced desktop sections.

rules.name: The Reported State Rule
rules.body: Emerald identifies native Kubernetes Running status. Rose identifies Down, Not found, Partial, or Error. These states tint the card, border, and icon badge. Native widget good, warn, and danger highlights use emerald, amber, and rose respectively. Pod state does not establish URL health.

dos: Do use real reported state for semantic tinting and retain its text label.
Do keep numeric telemetry monospace and tabular.
Do preserve native links, widget content, errors, and keyboard access.
donts: Don't invent presence, device controls, or sensor values.
Don't hide unavailable services or claim URL health from pod state.
Don't let the mobile dock cover the final content row.
